title: Permission guard regression: installments tab uses service_management:read instead of payments:update
note: The parent route guards with service_management:read. Users holding only payments:update (the old gate) are now locked out. Users with service_management:read see all controls but every write mutation fails with FORBIDDEN. Fix: also check payments:update before rendering write controls in InstallmentPlansTab, or accept service_management:update as the gate.

title: Future-dated price overrides insert successfully but are immediately invisible in list
note: listServicePriceOverrides filters lte(effectiveFrom, now()). A future effectiveFrom row inserts OK (toast fires) but never appears in the table. User cannot distinguish success from failure. Fix: either list all overrides (filter out only expired ones), or warn the user when effectiveFrom is in the future.

title: No cross-field validation: effectiveUntil < effectiveFrom inserts silently, row never displays
note: Neither client nor server checks effectiveUntil > effectiveFrom. Row inserts then immediately fails the list-query filter. Fix: add .refine() in the Zod schema and/or a service-layer guard.

title: Pricing page: isError not read from useQuery — fetch failure renders as empty state
note: isError not destructured from useQuery. Network failure shows 'No price overrides configured' identical to truly empty state. Fix: destructure isError, render StatusCallout on error.

title: Bulk toggle always shows success toast even when individual service updates fail
note: Promise.allSettled used but results never inspected. toast.success fires unconditionally. Fix: count fulfilled vs rejected, show partial-failure callout.

title: Services list fetch error renders as empty state (no isError handling)
note: useQuery for services.list doesn't surface isError. Network/auth failure shows 'No services yet' instead of an error callout.

title: Categories: duration=0 causes orphaned category row (client allows, server rejects after insert)
note: Agent-reported: client Zod min(0) allows duration=0 but server min(1) rejects config upsert after the category row is already inserted, leaving an orphaned DB row. Fix: raise client min to 1.

title: Categories list fetch error renders as empty state (no isError handling)
note: isError not read from useQuery on categories list. Network failure shows empty table.

title: Commission config query not invalidated after upsert — sheet shows stale data on re-open
note: Agent-reported: CategoryCommissionForm does not invalidate its query key after upsert. Reopening the sheet immediately shows old values.

title: Rooms: hierarchy query failure renders as empty form (no error state surfaced)
note: Agent-reported: if listNodes fails, branches silently becomes [] and form shows 'No branches found. Create a branch first.' indistinguishable from legitimately empty org.

title: Promotions: no reactivation path — deactivation is irreversible from the UI
note: Server update procedure accepts isActive:true but the edit form never sends it. Once deactivated, no UI control reactivates. Fix: add reactivation button on inactive promotion cards.

title: Promotions: deactivate dialog closes (target cleared) before mutation resolves — no retry on failure
note: Agent-reported: setDeactivateTarget(null) fires synchronously before mutation. On API failure, dialog is gone and user has no retry path.

title: Installments: duplicate plan code gives raw DB constraint error instead of friendly message
note: Agent-reported: unique-index violation on installment_plans_code_idx surfaces as unformatted internal error toast. Fix: catch the error by message pattern in the router or add a client-side uniqueness hint.

title: Installments: no reactivation path — disabling a plan is permanent from the UI
note: Agent-reported: no API endpoint and no UI to re-enable a disabled plan. Deferred — requires a new API procedure or extending update to accept isActive:true.
